title: ResearchTasksSpecification
description: JSON Schema defining structured research tasks configuration for M3 Research Decomposition & Planning module

project_id.description: Unique identifier of the research project

version.description: Semantic version of the task configuration

tasks.description: List of granular, executable research task units

_examples.description: Optional exemplary task items for illustration

metric_name.description: Name or descriptor of the quantitative/qualitative data point

assumption_tag.description: Mandatory non-empty identifier when source_type is estimated

task_id.description: Unique task identifier, e.g. T-01, T-P3-01

perspective.description: STORM-style expert persona/perspective driving this research unit

target_req_ids.description: Requirement IDs from brief.md mapped to and covered by this task

guidelines.description: Task-level research execution guidelines asserting data three essentials

output_path.description: Target evidence artifact path under fact-store/

dependencies.description: Task IDs of preceding dependencies forming an acyclic graph (DAG)

data_requirements.description: Expected numerical or factual indicators with source type classifications
